description: Eight party records at *0x685174 (stride 0x1862) and eight presence bytes at *0x685178 (stride 0x106) are all inputs. 0x41efb0/0x41eff0 (engine flag word), 0x5248a0 (dependency flag) and 0x520f90 (item search, mode 0, 12 slots) run natively; decoys sit in the dependency kinds 0/2, the 8 mode-nonzero item slots and the other fields of every 12-byte item slot. 0x504730 (D4) is address-stubbed: its args and call count are outputs, the caller ignores its eax. Random batch keeps the engine pointer at the arena object; null is covered by boundary rows.
